vedic_reference.note: Urmil is a Sanskrit name derived from the word उर्मि (urmi), meaning star. In Hindu mythology, Urmil is the name of a star in the constellation of Ursa Minor and the goddess of stars. The name is also associated with Lord Krishna, who is often depicted with stars in his eyes.
